omit.dsh-runtime: DSH is experimental and is excluded from public 0.2 binary releases. Complete packaging exceeds r267's 20,000-entry archive limit; support is deferred to a later update. Source metadata and the runtime catalog remain available.
omit.kimi-runtime: Kimi is experimental and is excluded from public 0.2 binary releases. Live kimi-r2 lacks a Linux PTY binding and relies on system/cached or downloaded ripgrep; its original packaging is not reproducible byte for byte. A corrected payload requires a new runtime identity. Source metadata and the runtime catalog remain available.
